title: Ollama (embeddings)
description: An embedding model served by Ollama, on this machine or your network, as gohort's semantic search: the request and the reply are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Pull the model first (ollama pull nomic-embed-text). The connector takes no key. gohort provides one, named ollama-embeddings and listed as Ollama embeddings; another, for a second server, is added from here. Choose it under Capabilities > Embeddings and give Ollama's address and the model there; Test there embeds two short sentences. An embedder on this machine or its network waits its turn behind the worker model, as chat does. nomic-embed-text wants its texts marked: set the query prefix to "search_query: " and the document prefix to "search_document: " under Capabilities > Embeddings. Switching embedders changes the embedding space: run Repair in the Vector Index panel to make stored documents searchable again, which embeds every one of them.

questions.name: name

questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the embeddings settings list it by this name.

config.name: model

config.help: An embedding model Ollama has pulled. The model names the embedding space: changing it later means re-embedding every stored document.
